text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle pesters me to go visit a<n>farm with her
on my day off...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It's not like the ones back<n>home, but a
farm's a farm!

There's so much energy here! The<n>smell of the
pastures, the hummin' of<n>the tractors...

The gentle breeze flowin' through the<n>farm, the
bellowin' of stampeding<n>cattle...
It's an emergency! The cows have<n>escaped!

We turn to see several cows running<n>through a
broken fence!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! They couldn't have<n>escaped at a better
time! Y'all leave<n>this to me, now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
S'all good! Wranglin' cows is what<n>my family
does! I'm used to this<n>kinda thing!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She approaches the escaped cows<n>from the side
while shouting<n>commands, and they're back where
they belong in no time flat.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whew! And that's more or less how<n>it's done!
That went surprisingly well<n>for bein' on my
lonesome!
choice_data_list: You'd never done it alone before?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haha, nope! My mom and I always<n>did it together
back home!

But never mind that! My body feels<n>way lighter
from all that herding!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I get the feelin' I can take my speed<n>up a notch and
make sharp turns right<n>on the heel!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yessiree! I'm so glad we got out to<n>this here farm!
Thanks for takin' me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I notice Taiki Shuttle's<n>running has
certainly improved a lot,<n>just like she predicted.
